details: Oil prices, specifically Brent crude, surged to a five-month high of $111.75 per barrel on Tuesday. This increase is attributed to a geopolitical risk premium following Houthi attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure and military targets, along with reports of vessel attacks in the Gulf. The escalating tensions raise concerns about global oil supply and inflationary pressures.
title: Brent Crude Hits 5-Month High Amid Middle East Attacks

details: US annual inflation climbed to 3.7% in September 2026, surpassing expectations and intensifying concerns regarding the Federal Reserve's monetary policy. This rise in inflation has put pressure on the cryptocurrency market, with Bitcoin experiencing a dip and spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) recording net outflows of $228.58 million for the week.
title: US Inflation Rises to 3.7%; Bitcoin Sees ETF Outflows

details: China's wealthiest families face an October 22 deadline to declare and pay a 20% tax on income from offshore trusts. This move by Beijing, aimed at boosting government revenue amidst economic challenges, is raising concerns among wealth advisers and lawyers about potential significant capital outflow from the country.
title: China's Wealth Tax Deadline Nears, Sparks Capital Flight Concerns
